name: Del Amo Fashion Center
description: Del Amo Fashion Center is one of the largest shopping malls in the United States, spanning over 2.5 million square feet in the heart of Torrance, California. This premier shopping destination features over 200 stores including luxury retailers, popular brands, diverse dining options, and entertainment venues, serving the affluent South Bay communities of Los Angeles County.
demographics: Affluent South Bay Los Angeles area with diverse demographics, serving Torrance, Redondo Beach, and surrounding communities with middle to upper-middle income households
summary: One of America's largest shopping destinations, Del Amo Fashion Center offers over 200 stores and upscale shopping in the heart of Southern California's South Bay.
